clips.title: The story
paras: Across the southern Barrens, Bramblescar's Razormane wage war with the Bristleback across the Gold Road. Thick brambles fortify their settlement.

Bramblescar is carved into the jagged briars of the southern Barrens. The thick, sharp thorns make a vital redoubt for the Razormane quilboar and deter casual wanderers. The tribe is fiercely territorial and hostile to outsiders. They skirmish with anyone who approaches, treating all who are not quilboar as intruders on land blessed by their ancient boar gods.

Bramblescar sits in perpetual tension with Agama'gor, the Bristleback encampment directly across the Gold Road. The rival tribes wage an unrelenting war for dominion over the southern Barrens. Razormane warriors fight Horde travelers along the highway and repel Bristleback raiding parties, keeping them on constant, violent alert.
